title: The kind that is built is the kind the card understood: each kind reads its own fields from the table
request: The owner: 'do all', in order; the live first conversation's largest gap (30 of 45 people wrong in both arms, mostly kinds whose Solution needs fields).
spec: STUDENTS_100_PLAN S9: S9.1 propose_fields per kind; S9.2 the proposal follows the card's family through the Solution route, the Home orchestrator and the harness; a kind that reads no outcome is built from the card. S9.3: Home asks a kind's missing field in the kind's words, and "I don't know" leads to the stated assumption or to the plain task, said.
plan: Read each kind's acceptance case for the fields it needs.
Split them: read from the table, assumed and said, or only the person's.
One module of proposers; the proposal sets a complete kind, suggests an incomplete one.
Wire the family through every caller; build a no-outcome kind from the card.
S9.3: one question per field only the person can give, kept in their words and read where the solution is proposed.
Decide what "I don't know" leads to for each field: an assumption that is safe, or the plain task, said in the summary.

decisions.decision: A field only the person knows is never guessed: an uplift's randomisation is asked; a forecast's horizon and a ranking's moment are assumed and said.
decisions.why: A wrong randomisation claim makes an uplift number meaningless; a horizon or a moment is a choice the person can see and change.

decisions.decision: An incomplete proposal is only suggested (kind_suggested), the plain kind kept.
decisions.why: Building a kind without its fields would fail or mislead; the page can ask.

decisions.decision: A segmentation's outcome column describes the segments and never forms them.
decisions.why: The replica's check: an outcome among the segmenting columns is a leak.

decisions.decision: Built in a separate worktree while the other session's gate ran.
decisions.why: Edits in the shared tree would have been tested by its gate.

decisions.decision: On "I don't know" whether an uplift offer was random, the kind runs as not at random, said as an assumption.
decisions.why: Not random is the cautious reading: the report then says who responded with the offer, never what it caused; the plain task would answer another question (who buys).

decisions.decision: A kind's question counts against the five and is asked after the card's own; past the cap, the summary says what is still needed.
decisions.why: The owner found many questions unintelligent; a missing field is said either way, never silently defaulted.

decisions.decision: No dclab-core change in S9: the ledger records a kind's question as "kind" in dclab_rnd.
decisions.why: The A7 session's uncommitted dclab-core version sits in the main tree; a version bump on the branch would block the merge.

change: dclab_rnd/kinds/propose.py (new: FieldProposal, the proposers, FAMILY_KINDS, NO_OUTCOME, for_family), dclab_rnd/studio/solution.py (propose family=, _family_kind), dclab_rnd/draft/api.py (the route passes the family; build_project _family_solution), dclab_rnd/draft/orchestrator.py, dclab_rnd/agent_eval/journeys/__init__.py (_save passes the family, keeps a built no-outcome solution and its moment), tests/test_kind_from_family.py (new). S9.3: kinds/propose.py (KindQuestion, QUESTIONS, read_said, question_for, options_for, still_needed, said_of; ranking's items table a named need), draft/chat.py (draft_table, kind_proposal, kind_question, kind_said; asked in next_turn and at a model turn's end; the summary says the kind), studio/solution.py (propose said=, tables=), draft/api.py, agentic/routers/projects.py (the project's Solution page reads the card it was built from), draft/orchestrator.py, agent_eval/journeys (said, tables), ledger/capture.py (a kind's question as "kind").

findings.defect: The card's family never reached the kind that was built.
findings.scenario: JH-forecasting-005 and -008 (Claude's card: forecasting) ran as regression; JH-time_to_event-000 and two segmentation people were refused or wrong.
findings.cause: kinds.resolve reads a declared kind, the pack, then the task; no kind proposed its own fields.
findings.fix: propose_fields per kind and the family through every caller.
findings.test: tests/test_kind_from_family.py; on the rules JH-time_to_event-000, JH-segmentation-000 and -003 now right on every part

findings.defect: A segmentation person's answer in words counted as an outcome.
findings.scenario: 'There is no outcome to predict, we just want the types found' left the target non-empty, so the no-outcome path never ran.
findings.cause: The check read whether a target was said, not whether it names a column.
findings.fix: The no-outcome path runs when the target names no column.

findings.defect: A segmentation's outcome formed the segments.
findings.scenario: The replica's check: the planted behaviours not recovered; renewed used to segment.
findings.fix: A yes/no column named as an outcome is proposed as the outcome that describes the segments.
findings.test: READ['segmentation'] in the test; the replays right

findings.defect: S9 cannot help where the card reads the family wrong.
findings.scenario: On the rules: ranking, embedded, a forecast and an uplift person still wrong (the rules read no family or the wrong one).
findings.cause: The rules' reading of the words (the understanding students' gap).
findings.fix: Measured with Claude's card in S9.4; the text student v2.

findings.defect: The project's own Solution page proposed without the card's family.
findings.scenario: A project built from a draft, its Solution opened on the project page: a forecast proposed as a regression again.
findings.cause: S9.2 passed the family in the draft's route, the orchestrator and the harness, not in the project router's _proposal.
findings.fix: _proposal reads the card the project was built from (project.draft.card), the person's kind answers and the attached tables.
findings.test: tests/test_kind_from_family.py (the route shares studio.solution.propose; covered by the wide tests)

findings.defect: A ranking was built from the card without its items table.
findings.scenario: A ranking draft built: the solution saved, then the first stage refused: 'The ranking machine reads the items table 'items': attach it'.
findings.cause: propose_fields read the log's columns only; RankingMachine needs the items table, always.
findings.fix: propose_fields(tables=): the items table is a named need when the attached tables are known and it is not among them; never asked, said in the summary.

findings.defect: "It was random, not chosen" read as chosen.
findings.scenario: The first reader checked the words of choosing before the words of randomness.
findings.fix: "not at random" first, then "random", then "someone chose"; an answer none of them reads stays missing.

findings.defect: The proposal set the kind's task but kept the plain task's metric, and "build it" dropped the kind.
findings.scenario: A 3-class text target with family text_or_images: task binary, metric macro_f1, "build it" refused; a forecasting draft's "build it" saved a plain regression while Home said "Kind: Forecasting".
findings.cause: _family_kind overwrote task only; quick_build's body, the wizard's Accept and the project editor never carried kind or kind_fields.
findings.fix: _family_kind keeps the target's task when the kind takes it and sets the kind's metric and options; "build it" carries kind, kind_fields and the kind's target; the wizard shows the kind with a box to untick (unticked: the plain task, its own metric); the project editor takes the kind from the fresh proposal on an outcome change.

findings.defect: The outcome could form the segments.
findings.scenario: A Telco-like table, `Churn` Yes/No named as the outcome, family segmentation: kind_fields {} and the segmentation machine read every column, `Churn` among them.
findings.cause: _segmentation ignored the target, and its outcome words had "churned" but not "churn".
findings.fix: The target named is the outcome column first, then specific outcome words (churn, exited, attrition, default, fraud...; never broad ones like "is", which would take the one slot from the real outcome); a kind that reads no outcome proposes no target; the build passes the outcome said in words when it names one column.

findings.scenario: "we did not run an A/B test", "there was no control group", "nobody was left out", "no randomisation, we targeted big spenders": randomised=True, and the uplift report would say what the offer caused.
findings.cause: The reader looked for words of randomness without their negation.
findings.fix: Each word of randomness or of choosing is evidence, negated within its own clause or not; both kinds at once leave the answer unread, never guessed.

findings.defect: A time-to-event proposal on its event read complete, and no save could pass.
findings.scenario: Target `cancelled` (the event): complete, then refused: 'The target of a time-to-event problem is its duration column'.
findings.cause: The proposer did not compare the target with the duration it read.
findings.fix: Suggested only, with the change said (choose the duration as the outcome, the event as its event); the duration read by its name is not named (it was months_billed, not days_subscribed).

findings.defect: A single series' weekday was taken as the series; monthly stores lost their season.
findings.scenario: One daily series with a weekday column: series=weekday (7 series); five stores monthly: the median step 0, no season, 7 by default.
findings.cause: On one series every date is unique; the step was measured on repeated dates.
findings.fix: A series column only where dates repeat; the step on the distinct dates.

findings.defect: The intern's and /mcp's propose_solution proposed without the card.
findings.scenario: The same project: a regression from the intern, a forecast from the page; the intern's call overwrote project.proposal.
findings.cause: Each caller passed its own arguments.
findings.fix: studio.solution.card_context(project), one helper for the project page, the intern, /mcp and the journeys.

findings.defect: DCLab's own solution was recorded as the person's.
findings.scenario: A segmentation (or anomaly) solution built from the card at the build: audit, memory and ledger said the person saved it.
findings.cause: saved_by fell back to "human" when no solution was saved on the page.
findings.fix: "agent" for a solution the build makes itself.

findings.defect: A new version with a new outcome was planned with the first card's family.
findings.scenario: A forecast card, then a yes/no outcome in a new version: the plan proposed a forecast's fields on it.
findings.cause: plan_new_version passed the draft card's family whatever the version's outcome.
findings.fix: The version's own family when it changed one; the card's only for the same outcome.

findings.defect: Writer B ended in a traceback at the gateway's cap and assembled nothing.
findings.scenario: 58 of 60 batches, EUR 2.97 of 3.00: the next request could cost up to EUR 0.06, the gateway refused it.
findings.cause: write() checked its own sum against the cap, not the gateway's refusal.
findings.fix: The refusal stops the run as the cap does, with the people assembled.

findings.defect: A kind's question was asked while its family was in dispute.
findings.scenario: The nightly gate on 10c77c72 (check-all, the other session): test_second_opinion's walk - the reader said regression, the rules time to event, the person did not choose - then Home asked time to event's duration column, and the walk waited for an answer.
findings.cause: kind_question presumed the card's family even when the second opinion on it was declined or open.
findings.fix: No kind question while a second opinion on the family is open or declined: the summary says the kind suggested.

findings.defect: A row number and an order id were offered as a duration; minutes were not read as a duration.
findings.scenario: The same walk: options ['Unnamed: 0', 'order_id', 'distance_km']; `actual_minutes` (the target) not proposed.
findings.cause: options_for offered every column not read; the duration words had days, weeks and months but no minutes or hours.
findings.fix: Options fit the field's type (a duration a number, an event a yes or no, a start a date), never a row number or a key, the target first when it fits; minutes, hours and seconds are durations.

outcome: Where the card reads the family, the kind and its fields are proposed and built; what only the person knows is asked or said as assumed.
lessons: A person's answer in words is not a column: check what it names, not whether it was said.
Check every caller of a proposal: one route without the new argument brings the old answer back.
A reviewer who probes with made-up tables finds what replica tests cannot: replicas name their columns plainly.
A proposal is a set of fields that must agree with each other (task, metric, kind): change one, check the others.
A question added to a conversation changes every walk that reaches it: run the suites of the walks (second opinion, coordinator), not only the new tests.
A new prompt file needs both suites: make agent-eval and make harness-eval.
risks: Name-based proposers can be fooled by unusual column names: each proposal says why, and the person can change it.
A kind's question adds one to a text problem without a source column; harness-eval shows whether the step-by-step journeys change.
